image_description: Two large blue plastic industrial drums (likely repurposed as rain barrels) standing side-by-side on a wooden pallet outdoors. The left drum has white labels, a green hose connected near the bottom, and a black pipe fitting at the very base. The right drum is similar in appearance with a hose connection visible. A chain-link fence and vegetation are in the background.
